messages:
nina: Heads up — incoming new hire Ana (F-1) has a tentative offer start of 2024-08-01. She filed OPT in May and says DSO will release SEVIS on 2024-07-25. Can we confirm what parts of onboarding we can run pre-EAD?

sam: Short: orientation/training yes (unpaid), no paid work until EAD is active and Form I-9 completed. Recommend we add clear contingent language to the offer.

candidate-ana: hi all! i'm Ana. i've uploaded passport + I-20 + USCIS receipt to the secure portal. i'll ping here when DSO confirms SEVIS release on 7/25 and again when/if EAD card arrives. thanks :)

immigration-vendor: For our checklist — candidate should upload: passport bio page, current I-20, USCIS receipt notice, any EAD images when issued, and I-94. We can do a preliminary eligibility review now but cannot clear payroll until EAD/I-9 verified. If SEVIS release is 7/25 we'll monitor.

nina: Plan proposal: 1) schedule virtual orientation 2024-08-01 as unpaid; 2) add offer addendum that compensation & benefits start upon verified work authorization; 3) set reminders to check SEVIS on 7/26. Thoughts?

payroll: That works. Note on retro pay: we can backdate payroll to the EAD effective date if the employee provides the EAD card and a completed I-9 showing the effective date. Otherwise payroll will start on the verified I-9 date. Send verified docs to payroll@redwood.com.

rita: I'll draft the addendum now. Draft language: "Orientation, onboarding activities, and training may occur prior to the employees proof of work authorization and will be unpaid. Employment and benefits enrollment are conditioned on the employee providing valid work authorization (e.g., EAD) and completing Form I-9; compensation will commence effective the verified authorization date." Anyone want edits?

candidate-ana: that language sounds good to me. i'll ask my DSO to confirm the SEVIS release date and will upload EAD immediately once it's issued.

people-ops-bot: [TASK CREATED] Onboard: Ana  OPT onboarding packet  assignee: nina  due: 2024-07-26

nina: thanks everyone. i'll update the offer addendum and schedule unpaid orientation. i'll close the loop after DSO confirmation.

people-ops-bot: [REMINDER] Check Ana document portal on 2024-07-26 for SEVIS/EAD updates
